# AI Bureau

> AI Bureau is a specialized engineering agency focused on designing and deploying autonomous intelligent systems, RAG-based knowledge infrastructures, and custom AI agent ecosystems for business automation.

## Core Expertise
- **Autonomous AI Agents**: Development of reasoning-capable agents for CRM/ERP integration, lead qualification, and 24/7 customer support. From 150,000 RUB.
- **Neural Knowledge Bases**: Enterprise-grade RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems for HR, consulting, clinics, and e-commerce. From 80,000 RUB.
- **eCommerce Intelligence**: Automated SEO content and product card generation for marketplaces (Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex.Market). From 50,000 RUB/mo.
- **Private Model Ops**: Local deployment of LLMs (Gemma 2, Llama 3) within secure perimeters via Ollama and vLLM. Air-gapped solutions for healthcare, legal, and industrial sectors.
- **Smart Fallback**: Proprietary dialog logic — when the bot doesn't know the answer, it asks clarifying questions instead of saying "I don't understand", and seamlessly hands off to a human manager with an AI-generated conversation summary.
- **AIO (AI Optimization)**: Enhancing web presence for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — making your business citable by Yandex.Neuro, Google AI Overview, and Perplexity.

## Services
- AI Audit & Strategy
- Custom LLM Integration
- Automated Lead Generation Systems
- Private AI Infrastructure Deployment
- GEO/AIO Optimization

## Technology Stack
- Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Open-source LLMs (Gemma 2, Llama 3)
- Ollama, vLLM for local deployment
- LangChain, Vector Stores (ChromaDB, Pinecone)
- RAG pipelines, Fine-tuning
